findings.text: the placed-step test passes `expected=(owned,)` to step_node_directories and then asserts that same value comes back, so both sides move together; the production wiring at reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:4094, which is what names the run's scratch for a real placed step, is guarded by no test and deleting that argument leaves all three tests green.
